EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
STATUTORY DETERMINATION UNDER SECTION 19 OF LAND REFORM LAW No. 1 OF 1972

SINCE, Mrs. Shyamini Tennakoon Adhihetty Gunarathna, the daugther of late Asanka Anoma Wijewardena TennakoonAdhihetty, at official Quarters of Gampola district judge, has made a late statutory declaration under Section 18 of theLaw with regard to the legacy of Asanka Anoma Wijewardena Tennakoon Adhihetty, when Land Reform Law came intoeffect, she and her brothers and sisters were minors and her father was alive, the Land Reform Commission, as per thepowers vested in it under Section 19 of the Law, the said Commission has affected a part of statutory determination onWalter Dayaratne Adhihetty's legacy. As he demised, specifying the portion of Agricultural Land owned by Walter DayaratneAdhihetty who is statutory lessee, which shall be allowed to retain, the agricultural land so allowed to be retained by thestatutory lessee is described in the Schedule below.
SAMPATH SUBASINGHE ARACHCHI,Chairman,Land Reform Commission.No. 475,Kaduwela Road,Battaramulla,17th July, 2018.

An allomtment of land marked Lot Nos. 545, 548, 549, 552, 553, 554, 556, 558 and 559 of the land called HakamuwaWatta, situated in the village Hakamuwa, in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 180, Lower Hakamuwa, of DivisionalSecretariat Rathnapura in the District of Rathnapura Sabaragamuwa Province containing in extent 22 Acres, 3 Roods,19.68 Perches (Hectares 9.2563) depicted in the final village plan No. 18 Supplement No. 34 sheet No. 34 made by theSurveyor General, together with the plantation and buildings thereon.
